validity.recommendation: Keep the row (real line); but re-cite it (the currently-cited egyptoil-gas Western Desert PDF does not name Shams or Obaiyed) and treat it as an upstream field-gathering trunk when reviewing PipelineType.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE = confirmed. The pipeline is independently attested: (1) GulfPub PE World Map lists 'Shams - Obaiyed Pipeline' operating (Shams field -> Obaiyed field, operator Khalda Petroleum Co, dia 20 in, 28 km); (2) Egypt Oil & Gas ('Phase III: Khalda Increases Gas Production at Hydra Field') and Petroleum Africa ('Khalda Completes Hydra Gas Development') both name 'the pipeline that runs from the Shams manifold to Obayied gas plant', with the Hydra field tied into it. So the real endpoints are the Shams manifold/field -> Obaiyed gas plant, both in the Khalda concession, northern Western Desert, Matruh Governorate. CAVEAT ON THE SHEET'S OWN SOURCE: the Status/Fuel/Type/Capacity/Length/Diameter/Owner cells all cite one generic egyptoil-gas.com Western Desert reservoir PDF (backlinks=15 on the shared gem.wiki page 'Obaiyed-Amreya_Northern_Gas_Pipeline'), and url_verifier confirms that PDF does NOT contain the tokens 'Shams' or 'Obaiyed' at all -- it is a country-overview report, not a source for this line. So the row's data was effectively single-sourced to a document that never names the pipeline. CLASSIFICATION caveat: this is an upstream field-gathering/collection trunk (raw field gas, Shams manifold to Obaiyed processing plant), not a national transmission trunk -- GEM's PipelineType='transmission' is arguable, though the whole Khalda Western Desert cluster in the roster is entered the same way. NOT A DUPLICATE: distinct from P6692 Qasr-Shams (Qasr GP -> Shams), P6693 Salam Spurline (Salam -> WDGP-N), and the Obaiyed-Amreya Northern family (P6687/P0474/P3934), which is the downstream *processed-gas export* trunk from the Obaiyed plant to Amreya, not the upstream Shams feed.

validity.recommendation: Replace Owner1 'General Petroleum Co' with Khalda Petroleum Company (Apache/EGPC JV) as operator; owner likely EGPC/Apache JV -- confirm the owner vs operator split with a human before applying.
validity.researcher_notes: Owner1 = 'General Petroleum Co' (100%) is almost certainly wrong. Shams and Obaiyed are assets of the Khalda concession, operated by Khalda Petroleum Company (KPC), the Apache/EGPC joint venture. Independent confirmation: Egypt Oil & Gas and Petroleum Africa both state Khalda operates the Obaiyed gas plant and the Hydra field feeding this line; GulfPub independently lists operator = Khalda Petroleum Co. 'General Petroleum Company' (GPC) is a separate EGPC affiliate that operates in the Gulf of Suez / Eastern Desert, NOT the Western Desert Khalda concession -- this looks like a mis-entry (possibly confusion with 'Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation'/EGPC). Note owner-vs-operator: KPC is the operator; the ultimate owner is the EGPC/Apache JV. Defer the exact owner% to human review; do not auto-apply.

routes.start_name: Shams manifold / Shams gas field (Khalda concession)
routes.end_name: Obaiyed gas plant / Obaiyed gas field
routes.corridor_desc: Upstream field line entirely within the Khalda concession, northern Western Desert, Matruh Governorate, Egypt. Obaiyed field/plant sits ~35 km SW of Marsa Matruh (~50 km south of the Mediterranean coast) on the western flank of the Matruh basin; Search & Discovery / geologic sources place the field at roughly 31.2 N, 26.6 E (approximate, from published field descriptions -- treat as +/- several km). The Shams manifold lies within the same concession, ~28-42 km from Obaiyed (length disputed: GEM 42 km, GulfPub 28 km), feeding the Obaiyed gas plant; Khalda's Hydra field ties into this same trunk ~8 km to its southwest. Exact Shams coordinates were not independently sourced, so start lat/lon left null; corridor bounded to the Obaiyed-Shams portion of the Khalda gathering system SW of Marsa Matruh.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from trade press naming the Shams manifold -> Obaiyed gas plant line and from the Obaiyed-field geologic abstract (~35 km SW of Marsa Matruh, western flank of Matruh basin). Obaiyed end coordinate ~31.2 N / 26.6 E is approximate, defensible from published field location (NOT a GPS-precise plant coordinate). Shams start coordinate not independently sourced -> left null rather than fabricated. No coordinates invented.

summary: P6688 Shams-Obaiyed is a REAL Khalda upstream field trunk (Shams manifold -> Obaiyed gas plant), but concerns: attribution (Owner 'General Petroleum Co' wrong -> Khalda Petroleum Co), spec (len 42 vs 28 km / dia 18 vs 20 in unconfirmed vs GulfPub), and its cited ref never names the line; caveat: gathering-trunk vs 'transmission'.
